row.body: I saved the cloth with white crystals for you. The seed trial crew passed Monday morning; my eyes began burning, and afterward the county van arrived.
row.title: Monday morning — white crystals

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same white crystals while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
